toegepas.rede_vinder: Two full clauses, each with its own subject and verb (Antarktika lê / ys bedek), are joined by 'en', so AWS 2017 requires a comma.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses ('Antarktika lê ...' and 'ys bedek ...') joined by 'en'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Each half has its own subject and verb, so the house rule requires the comma; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Dit is hoekom ons Antarktika saam met die ander ses kontinente tel.
toegepas.na: Daarom tel ons Antarktika saam met die ander ses kontinente.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dit is hoekom' copies English 'that is why'; 'Daarom' is the natural Afrikaans form, keeps the meaning and saves two words.
toegepas.fout: 'Dit is hoekom' copies English 'that is why'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Daarom' is the natural Afrikaans link, keeps the same reasoning and is shorter for a Grade 4 reader.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Under the house AWS rule a comma goes before 'want' only when both halves have a stated subject; the first half here is a command with no subject, so it takes no comma.
toegepas.fout: Comma before 'want' after a command half with no stated subject.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Under the house AWS rule a command half takes no comma before 'want'; meaning unchanged.

vlae.teks: 'n Eiland is 'n stuk land met water aan alle kante wat nie een van die sewe kontinente is nie.
vlae.rede: The relative clause 'wat nie een van die sewe kontinente is nie' stands after 'kante', so a young reader may attach it to the wrong word; putting it straight after 'stuk land' would be clearer, but this reads like a decided definition, so it is flagged rather than changed.
